scope: Initial publication snapshot; subsequent progress lives in GitHub and merged code

stories.title: Approve V1 scope, accounting policies and launch assumptions
stories.goal: freeze a reviewable accounting contract before production financial behavior is enabled
acceptance: Record Bangladesh service/non-stock scope, accrual BDT books and excluded features in a decision register
Approve COA/report mappings, recognition and cutover policies with reviewer identity and date
Treat 10% tax examples as illustrative and block unsupported compliance claims or invented tax rates
Record unresolved pricing, billing provider, retention and pilot-data decisions without pretending approval
stories.api: No runtime endpoint; reviewed architecture decision record

stories.title: Bootstrap the modular monolith, pinned toolchain and CI
stories.goal: give each AI a reproducible repository and test entry point
acceptance: Create Next.js TypeScript modular boundaries for accounting, reporting, contracts and permissions
Pin compatible provider/package versions and lockfiles after checking official docs
Provide environment examples without secrets and local setup, lint, typecheck, build and test commands
CI fails on type/lint/test failures and never deploys production from an unreviewed story

stories.title: Convert the 52-table reference into reviewed versioned migrations
stories.goal: obtain a reproducible schema rather than assume reference SQL is deployable
acceptance: Preserve all 52 catalogued entities and document deliberate field/constraint changes
Test clean install and upgrade path in isolated PostgreSQL/Supabase-compatible databases
Verify composite tenant keys, decimal types, indexes and least-privilege roles
List cross-row guards still unimplemented and keep financial writes disabled until engine gate
stories.api: Database migration commands; no public ledger CRUD

stories.title: Establish typed commands, authorization boundaries and error contracts
stories.goal: make every mutation use one validated service path
acceptance: Define money-as-string DTOs, organization context, expected_version and idempotency headers
Map validation, forbidden/not-found, stale version, period lock and conflict failures to documented errors
Server Actions and route handlers call shared domain commands rather than duplicate posting logic
Validate actor server-side and never trust actor IDs or editable user metadata from input

stories.title: Build deterministic fixtures and separate reference tests from application tests
stories.goal: make accounting correctness measurable from the first commit
acceptance: Run the provided Python reference and static suites with their limitations visible
Create isolated two-company, dual-membership and role fixtures with fixed dates and deterministic decimal expectations
Provide real PostgreSQL and service/browser test harnesses plus independent multi-connection race helpers
Track source T-01..T-52 and S-01..S-20 to real tests without counting skipped cases as passes

stories.title: Implement verified authentication, recovery and account security
stories.goal: enter the correct company securely and recover access
acceptance: Implement sign-up, sign-in, verification, recovery and profile/security routes with safe redirects
Use enumeration-safe messages and rate-limited resend/reset actions
Require recent authentication for sensitive owner, close/reopen and support grants
Test expired links, session revocation, unverified accounts and auth errors without leaking credentials

stories.title: Create a company with atomic onboarding defaults
stories.goal: start with a complete isolated set of books
acceptance: One transaction creates organization, owner membership, roles, approved default COA, mappings and periods
Collect company name, country, BDT currency, timezone, fiscal start and books-start date
Retry onboarding without duplicate companies or partially seeded accounting configuration
Reject unsupported currency and roll back all defaults on failure

stories.title: Build company selection and tenant-safe switching
stories.goal: work in separate company books without cached data leakage
acceptance: List only active memberships and preserve the user's valid company context
Scope database requests, server caches, query keys and download jobs by organization
Switching invalidates prior-company financial views and rejects stale cross-company submissions
A user belonging to both companies still cannot link A documents to B accounts

stories.title: Implement capability-based roles and last-owner protection
stories.goal: delegate work without exposing unrelated financial information
acceptance: Seed Owner/Admin/Finance/Accountant/Billing/Auditor capabilities and support bounded custom roles
Enforce read and mutation capabilities on API and DB-access paths, not only navigation
Reject unauthorized privilege escalation and concurrently removing the last active owner
Separate approval, posting, report, bank balance and export permissions

stories.title: Implement expiring invitations and immediate membership revocation
stories.goal: add colleagues safely and stop access when they leave
acceptance: Invite a verified recipient into an explicit organization and role with expiring single-use token
Accept/reject/resend without duplicate membership or unauthorized role grant
Check live membership on sensitive commands even when an old JWT remains valid
Revocation denies new evidence/export downloads and preserves audit history
stories.api: Invitation acceptance and membership revocation commands

stories.title: Enforce RLS, private schemas and scoped database routines
stories.goal: prevent tenant and module-level bypass through direct APIs
acceptance: Enable reviewed tenant/module RLS and restrict grants on every exposed table/view/routine
Use server-derived actor identity, restricted search_path and explicit execute grants where privileged routines are justified
Test ordinary authenticated, anonymous, billing, auditor and worker identities rather than only service_role
Views, caches, downloads and direct RPCs must not bypass capability or cross-tenant checks
stories.api: Database policies, RPC execution grants and scoped read model

stories.title: Manage company settings and protect accounting configuration
stories.goal: change company details without rewriting historical books
acceptance: Implement legal profile, timezone, fiscal year and books-start configuration with validation
Lock currency and foundational date policy after financial activity unless a reviewed migration path exists
Record material configuration changes with actor, reason and timestamp
Prevent overlapping fiscal periods and invalid books-start/cutover combinations

stories.title: Implement exact decimal, discount and rounding calculations
stories.goal: get identical totals in previews, posting and exports
acceptance: Use canonical decimal strings and exact arithmetic with documented half-up and line-total rules
Support six-decimal quantity/unit price and two-decimal monetary storage without JavaScript float authority
Validate negative/zero rules, excess scale, NaN, infinity and overflow at boundaries
Golden inclusive/exclusive illustrative tax and fractional quantity cases agree across service and database
stories.api: Shared calculation library and posting-preview contract

stories.title: Implement chart of accounts and posting mappings
stories.goal: maintain a stable, valid accounting structure
acceptance: Create/edit/archive account trees without cycles or posting into group/inactive accounts
Configure AR/AP, advance, cash, tax, rounding and retained earnings mappings with correct account types
Protect historical classification and prevent deleting used accounts
Show mapping errors before posting rather than silently using suspense

stories.title: Configure versioned tax rules and recovery treatment
stories.goal: calculate approved tax consistently while preserving issued documents
acceptance: Configure inclusive/exclusive tax and recoverable/nonrecoverable purchase treatment
Snapshot tax rate, basis and version into document lines before posting
Changes affect new drafts only and never mutate historical credit or invoice snapshots
Do not ship statutory filing, hardcoded Bangladesh legal rates or compliance certification

stories.title: Implement accounting dates, fiscal periods and shared lock protocol
stories.goal: stop backdated activity from bypassing closed books
acceptance: Resolve accounting date to a valid fiscal period and enforce books-start boundaries
All posting, settlement, unapply, import and reversal commands share a transaction-safe period lock protocol
Concurrent close either follows a committed financial operation or blocks it cleanly
Keep close/reopen events append-only and require reason plus elevated recent-auth permission
stories.api: Period guard service used by all financial commands

stories.title: Implement typed source documents, draft versions and state transitions
stories.goal: edit drafts safely without creating ledger effects
acceptance: Create typed source headers and matching trade/money/transfer/journal children
Keep accounting, settlement and delivery states separate
Draft edit uses expected_version, server totals and material snapshot digest
Posted financial fields become immutable and stale edits return a visible conflict

stories.title: Implement atomic posting and database-enforced ledger invariants
stories.goal: trust that each source has exactly one balanced financial effect
acceptance: Commit source state, at least two one-sided positive journal lines, control items, audit and outbox atomically
Reject unbalanced journals, source mismatch, wrong tenant/account/date/currency and incomplete building journals at commit
Block update/delete/truncate of posted financial facts through all runtime roles and alternate paths
Crash-after-commit and bounded whole-transaction retry return one existing source/journal rather than duplicate money
stories.api: Document post command and internal posting routine

stories.title: Implement permanent document numbering and idempotent commands
stories.goal: retry safely without duplicate vouchers or journals
acceptance: Allocate unique company/type/fiscal numbering inside the financial transaction
Same key plus same request returns original result and changed payload returns conflict
Different keys racing on the same source still produce at most one journal
Handle transient deadlocks with bounded whole-transaction retry and preserve permanent numbers after reversal

stories.title: Persist append-only financial audit events and transactional outbox
stories.goal: trace committed changes and reliably deliver follow-up work
acceptance: Write actor, organization, source version, action, reason and safe before/after metadata with the mutation
Outbox event creation is in the same transaction as posting with stable event IDs
Do not log passwords, tokens, full sensitive attachments or unrelated-company data
Audit records cannot be edited/deleted by ordinary users or silently replaced by delivery retries
stories.api: Internal audit append and outbox enqueue interfaces

stories.title: Prove the first invoice-to-ledger vertical slice before feature expansion
stories.goal: verify core accounting using executable integration evidence
acceptance: Create an isolated company, capital entry, earned invoice, partial receipt, ledger query and dated reversal through real commands
Match the golden no-tax scenario and reconcile AR/AP/control balances without dashboard shortcuts
Run PostgreSQL constraints and direct-routine permission tests under runtime roles
Attach commands, commit SHA and test results and keep the engine milestone blocked when required cases fail
stories.api: Service/DB vertical slice; full reporting UI delivered in M4

stories.title: Implement open-item control subledger primitives
stories.goal: explain every AR/AP/advance control balance by party and source
acceptance: Each posted control line creates exactly one matching same-tenant party/currency/control open item
Non-control lines cannot create unexplained items and ordinary manual control postings are rejected
Store immutable original amount, direction and effective accounting date
Provide available-balance primitives without maintaining a divergent editable balance table
stories.api: Internal control-item builder and scoped open-item reads

stories.title: Allocate opposite open items with historical and concurrent capacity checks
stories.goal: settle invoices without overusing receipts or rewriting past balances
acceptance: Validate same organization, party, currency, control and opposite direction
Lock affected item IDs in a deterministic order and enforce capacity at every effective-date boundary
Support partial and many-document allocation with no second income/expense journal
Reject backdated credit reuse that over-allocates any historical period and prove two-connection races safe
stories.api: POST allocations and as-of residual calculator

stories.title: Unapply settlements using dated append-only reversals
stories.goal: correct allocation mistakes while retaining historical statements
acceptance: Reverse each allocation at most once without modifying original allocation facts
Require effective reversal date on/after allocation and in an open period
Historical residual before reversal remains unchanged and later capacity becomes available correctly
Audit reason and block attempts to bypass period lock or historical capacity checks

stories.title: Save and approve versioned draft allocation plans
stories.goal: review exactly which invoices a receipt will settle
acceptance: Persist draft allocation targets, amounts and effective date under source version
Material changes invalidate approval and stale post attempts conflict
Validate live capacity again during posting rather than trusting a previous preview
Post source plus its approved allocations atomically with safe retries

stories.title: Implement controlled subledger adjustments and write-offs
stories.goal: correct receivables/payables without unexplained control balances
acceptance: Require party, control account, source evidence, adjustment reason and appropriate capability
Post balanced approved adjustment plus control item and settle explicitly
No unauthorized AR/AP netting for dual-role contacts or generic journal bypass
Show audit and ledger drilldown and test full reversal/correction path
stories.api: Controlled adjustment command using posting and allocation engines

stories.title: Build customer directory and customer financial profile
stories.goal: find customer invoices, collections and separate receivable balance
acceptance: Implement search/filter/pagination, validated create/edit/archive and contact snapshots
Show permission-scoped invoice, receipt, credit, advance and statement tabs
Keep customer and vendor controls separate for a shared contact
Opening balance edits route to cutover workflow rather than silently changing current balances
stories.api: GET/POST/PATCH contacts and scoped customer profile reads

stories.title: Build vendor directory and payable profile
stories.goal: understand each supplier balance without exposing it to billing-only staff
acceptance: Implement vendor search/filter/create/edit/archive with duplicate warnings
Show bills, payments, credits, advances and statement tabs under purchase permissions
Do not net shared customer/vendor balances or overwrite issued document identity
Reject guessed vendor IDs and cross-organization references
stories.api: GET/POST/PATCH contacts and scoped vendor profile reads

stories.title: Manage service/non-stock catalogue and cost-center tags
stories.goal: reuse accurate line defaults without pretending to track inventory
acceptance: Create/edit/archive service or non-stock items with units, default rate, posting account and tax
Allow validated cost-center tags with same-company constraints
Copy defaults as editable draft snapshots and preserve posted line history
Exclude quantity-on-hand, COGS costing and stock valuation from V1

stories.title: Build invoice register and versioned draft editor
stories.goal: prepare correct invoices with a clear accounting preview
acceptance: Implement invoice filters and line editor with customer, dates, terms, quantities, discounts, tax, notes and evidence
Show exact server-calculated totals and earned/deferred recognition selection
Save draft without GL impact and surface field errors plus stale-version conflicts
Submit/post buttons respect distinct permissions and never conflate email-sent with posted

stories.title: Post earned/deferred invoices and show immutable detail
stories.goal: recognize revenue only under the approved policy
acceptance: Earned invoice debits AR and credits earned revenue plus applicable approved tax
Future-service/deferred invoice uses configured liability treatment instead of premature revenue
Posted detail shows source journal, approval, residual, correction links and independent delivery state
Reject unauthorized, stale, closed-period or incomplete recognition inputs

stories.title: Record customer receipts and allocate partial or excess payments
stories.goal: collect dues without recording revenue twice
acceptance: Record external payment evidence, cash account, date, reference and gross amount
Allocate across eligible invoices with partial amounts and show remaining trade credit
A 6000 receipt on a 10000 invoice leaves 4000 AR and no new revenue
Disallow payment execution, over-allocation and unapproved changed allocation targets
stories.api: Receipt document create/preview/post and allocation commands

stories.title: Build supplier bill register and draft editor
stories.goal: capture purchase liabilities with accurate coding and evidence
acceptance: Capture vendor invoice reference, accounting/due dates, line expense-or-asset account, tax and receipt evidence
Warn about duplicate vendor references without deleting legitimate bills
Draft does not affect GL and server recalculates all totals
Preserve original vendor and tax snapshots and reject wrong-tenant items

stories.title: Post supplier bills and expose payable detail
stories.goal: recognize expenses/assets once and track vendor debt
acceptance: Debit approved expense/asset and recoverable input-tax accounts and credit AP
Handle nonrecoverable tax in the cost basis according to approved policy
Show immutable lines, journal, outstanding amount, approval and correction history
Prevent repeated posting or a payment from recognizing the expense a second time

stories.title: Record supplier payments with bill allocations
stories.goal: reduce payable balances with clear cash evidence
acceptance: Capture paid-from account, external reference, amount and date without sending money
Debit AP and credit cash/bank once with partial/multiple bill allocations
Show unallocated trade debit separately from true supplier advances
Revalidate approved plan and cash/period/capacity constraints atomically

stories.title: Record paid expenses with correct asset and tax treatment
stories.goal: capture already-paid purchases without misclassifying equipment
acceptance: Implement amount/vendor/date/paid-from/coding/tax/notes/attachment entry and register
Allow equipment and prepaid purchases to debit assets rather than force every purchase to expense
Apply approved recoverability rules and maker-checker policy
Post one balanced cash event and preserve audit/correction links

stories.title: Implement dated source reversals and dependency safeguards
stories.goal: correct posted mistakes without deleting accounting history
acceptance: Create a new exact opposite journal linked to the original source and preserve both entries
Allow one effective reversal with authorized reason in an open period
Require settlement unapply and authorized reconciliation reopen where dependencies exist
Reject partial arbitrary source rewrites, second reversals and original-date substitution in locked books

stories.title: Issue customer credit notes against original invoice lines
stories.goal: reduce earned/deferred revenue and tax by only the approved eligible amount
acceptance: Reference the correct original invoice and line, preserving its tax and recognition snapshots
Enforce cumulative credit quantity/value limits including previous credits
Post appropriate opposite revenue/deferred/tax components and a credit open item
Show draft/approved/posted detail and allocate credit without creating cash movement

stories.title: Record customer refunds limited to eligible credit
stories.goal: return recorded money without creating unexplained receivable balances
acceptance: Select eligible unallocated customer credit and refund cash/bank account
Reject amounts exceeding eligible credit or physical-cash capacity
Post refund and consume credit atomically with date, evidence and approval
This records an external refund and must not initiate a bank transfer

stories.title: Record vendor credits and supplier refunds
stories.goal: correct purchases while keeping AP, input tax and cash reconciled
acceptance: Vendor credit references eligible original bill lines and original recoverability snapshots
Apply cumulative original-line limits and correct expense/asset/input-tax reversals
Record supplier refund only against eligible trade debit with separate cash evidence
Expose allocation, approval and reversal history and reject cross-vendor credits
stories.api: Vendor credit and supplier refund commands

stories.title: Record true customer and supplier advances
stories.goal: distinguish prepayments from revenue, expense and ordinary trade credit
acceptance: Customer advance debits bank and credits customer-advance liability
Supplier advance debits supplier-advance asset and credits bank
Create party/control open items and show unapplied advance balances separately
Require amount/date/account/evidence and do not treat advance cash as earned revenue or incurred expense

stories.title: Apply advances through reclassification and paired allocations
stories.goal: settle trade balances without counting cash twice
acceptance: Customer application debits advance liability and credits AR; supplier application debits AP and credits advance asset
Create the required control items and two matching allocation sets in one transaction
No second bank movement, income or expense is created by application
Revalidate approved allocation plan, party/control identity, effective dates and historic capacity

stories.title: Refund unused advances and expose full lifecycle
stories.goal: return only the remaining prepayment and preserve applied history
acceptance: Select unapplied advance balance and record external refund to/from the correct bank
Reject refunds exceeding remaining eligible advance after existing applications
Post the correct advance-control and cash legs with linked settlement
Show original advance, applications, refunds, unapply/reversal links and residual without netting trade credit

stories.title: Configure cash, bank and wallet ledger accounts
stories.goal: maintain separate money accounts with valid posting mappings
acceptance: Create cash/bank/wallet metadata mapped to one appropriate same-company GL account
Show balances from posted ledger and carry no independent editable current-balance field
Protect used mappings and allow archive rather than destructive deletion
Wallet entries record balances only and do not claim bKash/Nagad API integration

stories.title: Build bank/cash ledger and physical-cash balance guard
stories.goal: see real money movements and prevent unsupported cash spending
acceptance: Provide opening, inflow, outflow, running/closing balance and source drilldown by date
Restrict bank-balance visibility separately from billing access
Enforce configured physical-cash nonnegative policy with transaction-safe account locking
Test concurrent spends and show any permitted overdraft policy explicitly for bank accounts

stories.title: Post atomic bank transfers with explicit fees
stories.goal: move recorded money without inflating revenue or cash flow
acceptance: Require distinct eligible source/destination accounts, amount, accounting date and reference
Post both principal legs and any separately coded fee atomically
Internal cash-equivalent principal is excluded from external cash-flow totals while fees remain classified
Retry safely and reject insufficient physical cash, wrong tenant, same account and locked period

stories.title: Build journal register and controlled manual journal editor
stories.goal: record legitimate adjustments without bypassing control subledgers
acceptance: Provide account/debit/credit line editor, balanced preview, date, description and evidence
Reject one-line, unbalanced, double-sided or ordinary direct AR/AP/advance entries
Require approval and a valid accounting period before posting
Register/detail expose immutable lines, source links and dated reversal history

stories.title: Implement General Ledger and Trial Balance drilldowns
stories.goal: reconcile all account activity directly to posted journals
acceptance: Ledger supports account/date/source filters, opening and running balances with stable pagination
Trial Balance sums posted debit/credit and reports imbalance rather than manufacturing a balancing plug
Each total drills down to journal then source under the viewer's permissions
Include reversals by effective date and reconcile the golden business fixture

stories.title: Import bank statements with safe mapping and deduplication
stories.goal: bring statement observations into reconciliation without posting money
acceptance: Support staged CSV/XLSX account/date/amount/reference mapping with preview and row errors
Exact file/provider transaction keys are idempotent and ambiguous equal-value fingerprints require review
Normalize signs, dates and BDT values without silently dropping legitimate equal transactions
Importing observations creates no GL entries and unsafe files are rejected/quarantined

stories.title: Build partial and many-to-one reconciliation matching
stories.goal: match bank observations to existing ledger cash lines
acceptance: Workspace shows statement and book sides with dates, references, residual amounts and match suggestions
Allow partial and many-to-one matches only for compatible account/currency/direction
Lock capacity on both sides so concurrent matches cannot overconsume
Matching is evidence association only and never creates a duplicate journal

stories.title: Finalize and reopen reconciliations with immutable evidence
stories.goal: close only fully explained statement differences
acceptance: Require reconciled opening/closing balances and zero unexplained difference before finalize
Protect finalized match sets and overlapping reconciliation coverage
Reopen requires reason, elevated capability and audit while retaining previous evidence
A reconciled payment cannot be reversed until the authorized dependency-resolution path completes

stories.title: Implement staged structured data imports and resumable error handling
stories.goal: migrate validated records without bypassing accounting commands
acceptance: Separate upload, mapping, validation, preview and explicit commit with row-level errors
Declare atomic batch scope and retry keys so rerun never duplicates posted records
Route financial rows through the same period/approval/posting guards as interactive commands
Restrict job access and retain sanitized error reports and import provenance

stories.title: Implement opening-balance and mid-year cutover wizard
stories.goal: start new books with reconciled balances and historical YTD once
acceptance: Require cutover date, prior trial balance and detailed AR/AP/advance open items
Tie each control total to detail and block approval/commit while suspense is nonzero
Post approved opening balance without fabricating historical sales and label summarized YTD properly
Annual P&L includes pre-cutover summary once and subsequent detail once with evidence export

stories.title: Create report hub with consistent cutoff, filters and snapshot contract
stories.goal: compare financial reports using the same source-of-truth context
acceptance: Expose approved report directory and standard date/as-of/account/cost-center filters
Use posted ledger and effective-date subledgers with consistent database read boundaries
Capture company, timezone, cutoff, filters, generation time and draft/provisional labels
Drilldown and export authorization match the report rather than tenant membership alone
stories.api: GET reports/[type] and report snapshot interface

stories.title: Implement accrual Profit and Loss with correct cutover and close behavior
stories.goal: understand earned performance without cash or year-close distortions
acceptance: Revenue and expenses derive from classified posted nominal accounts by period
Exclude year-close transfer mechanics from historical performance calculations
Include mid-year opening YTD summary exactly once and show comparison/drilldown
Golden fixture returns revenue 10000, expense 5000 and profit 5000

stories.title: Implement Balance Sheet without retained-profit double counting
stories.goal: reconcile assets, liabilities and equity at any cutoff
acceptance: Group classified assets, liabilities and equity with source drilldown
Add only untransferred earnings not already moved to retained earnings by active close
Reversal/reclose preserves correct historical and current statements
Golden fixture reconciles assets 106000 to liabilities 1000 plus capital 100000 plus profit 5000 without plugs

stories.title: Implement historical AR/AP aging and credit presentation
stories.goal: see what was actually due on a selected date
acceptance: Compute residual from item, allocation and unapply effective dates instead of today's balances
Age invoice/bill debt using documented due-date buckets and show unapplied credits separately
Keep AR/AP and true advances distinct even for dual-role contacts
Historical backdated-credit fixtures and control tie-outs pass with permitted source drilldown

stories.title: Build customer and vendor statements with allocation history
stories.goal: explain each party's opening balance, movements and closing due
acceptance: Filter party and date range with opening/running/closing balances derived as of dates
Show invoices/bills, money, credits, advances and allocation references distinctly
Do not net customer and vendor positions or expose unrelated party information
Printable/export-ready statement totals reconcile to controls and preserve generation context

stories.title: Implement classified management cash-flow report
stories.goal: distinguish operating, investing and financing cash movements
acceptance: Classify cash-equivalent line movements using approved mapping and exclude noncash transactions
Eliminate internal cash-equivalent principal transfers and classify fees explicitly
Reconcile opening cash plus net movement to closing cash and flag missing classifications
Unclassified movement makes the report provisional and blocks finalization; golden fixture shows financing 100000 and operating 2000

stories.title: Implement month/period close checklist and controlled reopen
stories.goal: lock only reconciled books and preserve closing evidence
acceptance: Show unresolved approvals, control tie-outs, bank differences, suspense and classification exceptions
Require successful close checks and authorized recent-auth action with immutable snapshot
Enforce lock on all financial posting/allocation/unapply/import paths under races
Reopen retains prior snapshots, records reason and requires explicit reclose review

stories.title: Implement fiscal-year close, retained earnings and reclose history
stories.goal: transfer profit once without destroying performance reports
acceptance: Require prerequisite period/reconciliation/control checks and approved close mappings
Post classified year-close transfer with exactly one active close run per fiscal year
Reopen/reclose reverses prior mechanics safely and preserves run/snapshot history
Historical P&L excludes mechanical closing lines while Balance Sheet never adds transferred profit twice

stories.title: Build ledger-driven finance dashboard with safe drilldowns
stories.goal: review revenue, profit, liquidity and dues in one coherent view
acceptance: Show earned revenue, expenses, net profit, cash/bank, AR/AP and overdue items with date context
Charts and KPI totals use shared report queries rather than separate transaction arithmetic
Differentiate cash movement from accrual performance and label provisional/empty states
Capability-restricted roles do not receive hidden profit/bank data in page payload or cache
stories.api: Dashboard summary backed by report service

stories.title: Configure approval policies and explicit sole-operator exceptions
stories.goal: enforce the right maker-checker controls per document
acceptance: Configure versioned policy, thresholds, approver capability and submission requirements
Prevent unauthorized weakening of policy or self-granting approval roles
Sole-operator exception requires explicit configuration and audit rather than silent bypass
Snapshot the applicable policy when a document is submitted

stories.title: Implement version-bound submit, approve, reject and posting checks
stories.goal: approve exactly the financial effect that will be posted
acceptance: Submission stores source version, material digest, allocation targets and policy snapshot
Separate submit, approve and post permissions and reject maker self-approval unless explicit policy permits
Any material edit invalidates approval and requires resubmission
Posting rechecks current authorization, approved version/digest and live allocation capacity atomically

stories.title: Build approval inbox and evidence-based review workspace
stories.goal: review pending financial changes without editing their facts
acceptance: List only reviewable requests with type, maker, amount, age and policy
Show source lines, attachments, posting preview, previous decisions and changed-version warning
Approve/reject requires reason where policy demands and protects against stale review
Reviewer cannot silently modify submitted amounts or gain posting permission

stories.title: Build scoped audit search and readable change history
stories.goal: trace financial decisions without exposing private secrets
acceptance: Filter actor/date/entity/action with stable pagination and source links
Show immutable creation, submission, approval, posting, correction and close events
Redact forbidden fields and respect module/tenant capabilities in search and detail
Read-only auditors cannot mutate records through hidden controls or direct calls
stories.api: Audit event search and entity timeline reads

stories.title: Build private evidence library and immutable document linking
stories.goal: find supporting receipts and bank slips without public storage exposure
acceptance: List only permitted attachments with source/category/upload status and safe metadata
Link validated evidence to drafts and preserve posted-evidence history on correction
Download requires current organization and source-module permission with short-lived URLs
No public bucket, guessed-object access or silent replacement of an issued snapshot

stories.title: Implement private upload, quarantine and authorized downloads
stories.goal: keep financial evidence isolated and safe throughout its lifecycle
acceptance: Create upload intents with generated company-scoped object keys, bounded size/type and expiring permission
Verify actual content, scan/quarantine policy and completion ownership before linking
Use current authorization for downloads and document the bounded lifetime of previously issued signed links
Reject path traversal, forged MIME, unsafe filename and cross-tenant worker/object access

stories.title: Implement leased outbox workers and idempotent retry delivery
stories.goal: recover email/export failures without reposting financial events
acceptance: Claim jobs with bounded leases, retry/backoff and dead-letter visibility
Use stable event IDs and provider idempotency where available for at-least-once work
Worker crash or renderer failure never reverses/reposts the committed journal
Restrict worker data access to the event organization and record safe failure metadata

stories.title: Implement scoped import/export job orchestration
stories.goal: track long-running work without leaking financial files
acceptance: Persist requested org/user/filter/cutoff and immutable job parameters with safe status transitions
Prevent access to another user's/company's job and recheck authorization at download
Make retries idempotent, store bounded-lifetime output privately and clean failed temporary objects
Expose progress, cancellation where safe and actionable row/render errors

stories.title: Generate Unicode invoice PDFs and deliver versioned emails
stories.goal: send professional documents without changing accounting status
acceptance: Render issued customer/tax/line snapshots with BDT and Bangla/English Unicode text
Record immutable PDF version and recipient/delivery result separately from settlement/posting
Queue email with retry and prevent duplicate sends from repeated request handling
Delivery failure preserves the journal and allows authorized resend without reissuing revenue

stories.title: Export filtered reports and statements to safe PDF/CSV/XLSX
stories.goal: share numbers that match the reviewed report snapshot
acceptance: Generate output from the same permitted report/cutoff/filter context as the screen
Include company, period, currency, generation time and provisional labels
Escape spreadsheet formulas and preserve decimal/Unicode formatting
Recheck permission before issuing download and document short signed-link lifetime

stories.title: Build notifications and preference-aware financial reminders
stories.goal: notice approvals, overdue invoices and due bills without duplicate noise
acceptance: Provide scoped in-app unread/read notifications and permitted source links
Configure supported email preferences and deduplicate scheduled reminder events
Do not include unauthorized bank/profit data in previews, email or logs
Retry delivery only and never let a notification create an accounting entry

stories.title: Enforce subscription plans, seats and safe read-only states
stories.goal: use commercial plans without risking accounting integrity
acceptance: Define approved plan entitlements and validate seats/features on the server
Concurrency cannot bypass seat limits and expiry cannot interrupt a financial transaction halfway
Expired/downgraded companies retain records and policy-based read/export access
Tenant isolation, corrections, balanced books and period protection are not premium-only safeguards

stories.title: Integrate verified billing checkout and idempotent webhooks
stories.goal: activate paid access only from trustworthy provider events
acceptance: Implement the explicitly selected provider adapter and sandbox checkout without inventing live credentials
Verify raw-body signatures, event identity, tenant binding and out-of-order lifecycle changes
Duplicate webhooks produce one entitlement result and failed processing safely retries
Platform subscription events do not post into customer-company GL

stories.title: Build truthful landing, pricing and trial entry pages
stories.goal: understand the product and choose an approved plan
acceptance: Show actual implemented scope, plan differences and authorized trial/contact path
Use only owner-approved prices, client claims, testimonials and commercial terms
Label demo financial values and clearly distinguish bookkeeping from bank/payment operation
Link security, export and privacy information and keep accessibility/responsive behavior usable

stories.title: Build consented and time-bounded support operations console
stories.goal: diagnose SaaS issues without silent access to client books
acceptance: Default support view contains operational metadata only, not tenant ledger/evidence
Exceptional access requires explicit company consent, approved purpose, duration and recent authentication
Log each privileged access and revoke on expiry or owner withdrawal
Test support access without consent, guessed org IDs and excess module scope

stories.title: Add privacy-safe observability, alerts and abuse limits
stories.goal: detect failures without exporting customers' financial data into logs
acceptance: Emit request IDs, safe command error codes, queue age, backup age and authorization failure metrics
Redact tokens, passwords, full invoices and unrelated company identifiers from telemetry
Configure actionable posting/worker/billing alert thresholds and rate limits
Run controlled failures to demonstrate incident signals and preserve financial transaction invariants

stories.title: Rehearse database and object-storage recovery separately
stories.goal: restore complete books with their supporting evidence
acceptance: Select funded backup/PITR, object version/backup and retention policies explicitly
Restore into a clean isolated environment and reconcile journals, open items, artifacts and access controls
Measure achieved RPO/RTO against proposed targets instead of claiming provider defaults guarantee them
Record recovery commands, incident ownership, missing-object checks and evidence
stories.tables: all financial tables and private object storage
stories.api: Backup/restore runbook and isolated recovery tests

stories.title: Document and verify environment deployment and safe rollback
stories.goal: release changes without undoing customer accounting history
acceptance: Separate development, staging and production secrets/data and pin deployment dependencies
Run migration compatibility checks and keep queued-event consumers compatible with released schemas
Document application rollback that does not restore old DB backups over committed books
Verify staging smoke tests, health checks and operator escalation before paid release
stories.api: Deployment/rollback pipeline and runbook; production requires explicit authorization

stories.title: Approve retention, export and account-termination policy
stories.goal: honor data access and retention obligations without accidental destruction
acceptance: Record jurisdiction/business-specific retention, residency and deletion decisions with reviewer evidence
Specify export ownership, billing expiry versus deletion, backups and signed-link residual access
Never invent a statutory retention period or auto-delete books when a subscription ends
Rehearse the approved non-destructive termination/export path in isolated fixtures
stories.api: Reviewed retention/termination policy and permitted account lifecycle

stories.title: Build accessible application shell and reusable finance UI components
stories.goal: navigate consistently across company finance workflows
acceptance: Implement org-scoped navigation, breadcrumbs, session state and responsive layout
Provide MoneyInput, account/party pickers, line grid, posting preview, audit drawer and confirmation patterns
Use keyboard navigation, visible focus, labeled errors and Unicode-safe formatting
Components do not compute authoritative balances or expose hidden unauthorized data
stories.api: Shared layout and component library; no financial posting implementation

stories.title: Add stable list search, saved filters and keyboard efficiency
stories.goal: find daily records quickly without unsafe client-side data dumps
acceptance: Persist permitted filters in URL/user scope and use stable server pagination
Search only allowed customer/vendor/invoice fields with bounded query size
Keyboard shortcuts respect focused inputs and unsaved-change prompts
Changing company invalidates saved selections that reference another tenant
stories.api: Scoped list/search queries and filter preferences

stories.title: Finish accessible loading, conflict, empty, offline and read-only states
stories.goal: understand failure states without accidentally resubmitting money
acceptance: Implement loading/empty/forbidden/expired-session/locked-period/conflict states with recovery actions
Disable financial submission offline and never queue offline posting as if accepted
Read-only subscription state permits approved access but no hidden write path
Verify keyboard focus, error summaries, narrow-screen tables and retry-with-idempotency UX
stories.tables: UI state only; existing source/job contracts

stories.title: Execute all 52 business and 20 security/concurrency acceptance cases
stories.goal: prove the complete application meets its financial and isolation contract
acceptance: Map all T-01..T-52 and S-01..S-20 to executable DB/service/browser tests with evidence
Use anonymous, ordinary member, role-template and worker identities plus genuine multi-connection race tests
Run golden books, cutover, period/year close, billing replay, signed-download and crash-recovery scenarios
Resolve critical/high money/access/recovery defects and report skips or unavailable external tests honestly
stories.api: Full integration/E2E/security test suite and coverage report

stories.title: Benchmark the declared pilot load and fix measured bottlenecks
stories.goal: know whether the application supports the proposed operating envelope
acceptance: Declare test hardware/database/network, concurrency and dataset before benchmarking
Exercise 100 companies, up to 20 members/company and 100k ledger lines/company without cross-tenant leaks
Measure p95 reads under 500ms, posting up to 100 lines under 1s and typical reports under 3s as targets, not guarantees
Attach reproducible load scripts, query plans and measured outcomes; optimize without weakening accounting guards
stories.api: Performance test harness and reviewed query optimization

stories.title: Run three restricted pilots and record independent sign-off
stories.goal: validate real closing workflows before general release
acceptance: Obtain permission and safe data policy for at least three pilot organizations
Each pilot completes a reconciled period with bank/control/report tie-outs and correction/reopen exercise
An independent accounting reviewer and security reviewer record findings and approval, not AI-generated sign-off
Track usability and critical defects to resolution with actual evidence
stories.api: Restricted pilot operations; human review gate

stories.title: Make the documented release decision and operator handoff
stories.goal: launch only after verified accounting and operational gates pass
acceptance: Publish actual supported scope, limitations, training and support escalation documentation
Confirm reviewer sign-offs, restore evidence, billing sandbox verification and unresolved-defect register
Record release artifact/commit, deployment approval and rollback/operator ownership
No production launch or payment execution occurs merely because this planning issue exists
stories.api: Release checklist and explicitly authorized deployment handoff

stories.title: Discover recurring transaction drafts and scheduling policy
stories.goal: reduce repeated data entry without hidden automatic posting
acceptance: Write a separate PRD covering recurrence dates, timezone, retries, duplicate prevention and stop/resume
Default generated transactions to reviewable drafts with current permission/period checks
Specify future schema, UI and acceptance-test impact
No production recurring/autopost behavior ships under this discovery issue

stories.title: Discover budgets, project profitability and cost allocation
stories.goal: plan spend and assess projects using reconciled accounting data
acceptance: Define budget versions, project/cost-center hierarchy and actual-versus-budget formula
Resolve allocation, refunds, shared overhead and period comparison policy with accounting reviewer
Propose drilldowns, permissions and schema without inventing current profitability data
Create separately approved implementation stories after discovery

stories.title: Discover receipt AI extraction and draft categorization
stories.goal: save entry effort while retaining human control of books
acceptance: Specify extraction confidence, evidence citations, privacy/provider boundaries and editable drafts
AI output cannot autonomously post, pay, approve or override accounting guards
Define evaluation set including Bangla/English receipts, tax ambiguity and duplicate scans
Propose model adapter, costs, consent and failure handling with human approval gate

stories.title: Discover multi-currency and realized/unrealized FX accounting
stories.goal: expand beyond BDT without silently corrupting historic balances
acceptance: Define functional/document/settlement currencies, rate sources and immutable rate snapshots
Resolve realized/unrealized gains, rounding, credit/refund and closing rules with reviewer
Design migration and report reconciliation tests preserving V1 BDT history
Do not enable foreign-currency posting until the separate PRD is approved

stories.title: Discover inventory quantity, valuation and cost-of-goods integration
stories.goal: connect stock movements to accounting under an explicit costing method
acceptance: Choose costing and negative-stock policy with purchase/sale/return/cutover examples
Specify atomic stock-to-ledger events, units, valuation and race controls
Document migration from non-stock V1 without retrospectively fabricating stock
Produce reviewed tests and separately scoped implementation backlog

stories.title: Discover payroll runs and restricted salary accounting
stories.goal: record approved payroll without exposing employee pay
acceptance: Define compensation inputs, salary payable, advances, deductions and payment reconciliation
Require jurisdiction-specific payroll/tax review rather than invented legal formulas
Specify sensitive-data roles, approved runs, corrections and payslip privacy
No payroll or bank execution is enabled during discovery

stories.title: Discover asset register and depreciation lifecycle
stories.goal: track assets with approved periodic accounting
acceptance: Define asset acquisition, capitalization, depreciation method, useful life, disposal and impairment boundaries
Specify approved schedules, period lock, reversals and change-of-estimate handling
Reconcile asset register to existing GL without duplicating already-booked acquisitions
Deliver separate reviewed schema/UI/tests before implementation

stories.title: Discover reviewed Bangladesh VAT, withholding and statutory outputs
stories.goal: produce local records only when actual obligations are verified
acceptance: Identify applicable business regime and current authoritative requirements with reviewer citations
Specify rate/version changes, withholding events, Mushak or other required records and filing boundaries
Do not equate configurable tax totals with certified statutory compliance
Create reviewed sample outputs and separate implementation acceptance cases
stories.api: Discovery document only; human tax review required

stories.title: Discover live bank-feed adapters and reconciliation sync
stories.goal: receive trustworthy statement data without duplicate observations
acceptance: Assess approved providers, consent, connection scopes, polling/webhooks and revoked-access behavior
Specify provider transaction keys, pending/final changes, replay, dedup and reconciliation linkage
Keep statement ingestion separate from ledger posting and payment execution
Document sandbox verification, cost and adapter-specific acceptance cases

stories.title: Discover authorized payment execution and fraud controls
stories.goal: assess money-movement functionality separately from bookkeeping
acceptance: Choose approved provider and legally supported operation before implementation
Specify explicit user authorization, maker-checker, amount/payee binding, limits and recent authentication
Design idempotency, provider status reconciliation, failures/refunds and incident response
No real transfer, credential sharing or autonomous AI payment is authorized by this issue

stories.title: Discover estimates, customer portal and purchase-order workflows
stories.goal: extend commercial collaboration without premature accounting entries
acceptance: Define estimate-to-invoice and PO-to-bill boundaries with explicit non-posting states
Assess portal identity, permitted document visibility and customer/vendor actions
Specify change/version approval and optional matching policy without forcing enterprise scope into V1
Split approved workflows into new implementation stories and testable UI contracts

stories.title: Discover partner access, enterprise SSO and consolidation boundaries
stories.goal: assess enterprise requirements without weakening separate company books
acceptance: Separate discovery tracks for accountant partner access, SSO lifecycle and group reporting
Consolidation track must resolve intercompany elimination, currency and ownership policy with reviewer
Document cross-organization authorization and migration/security test requirements
Prioritize tracks and create separate approved PRDs rather than implementing an undefined enterprise bundle

epics.11: SaaS billing, security operations and recovery
epics.12: Product usability, quality and release gates

0: Approve the product and accounting assumptions. No AI may fabricate professional sign-off.
1: Reproducible toolchain, migrations, authentication, tenancy, permissions and private evidence primitives.
2: Exact decimal rules, source lifecycle, transactional ledger, approvals, allocations and correction primitives; pass the first real-DB vertical slice.
3: Implement the daily finance screens against proven commands. Cash controls, correction paths and representative end-to-end examples must reconcile.
4: Reconcile imports, statements, historical subledgers, month close and year closing. Complete feature-specific DB guards and tests.
5: Approved billing provider sandbox, delivery/export jobs, support controls, observability, restore evidence and commercial/privacy decisions.
6: M6 — Independent pilot and release gates
All application tests, measured performance, three authorized restricted pilots, independent review and an explicit release decision.
7: Separate PRDs and reviewed acceptance criteria. These stories do not authorize implementation, compliance claims, real payments or scope expansion.
